（一国除首都以外的）全部地区，所有区域
（通常指有某种特性或问题的）身体部位
en: a large area of land, usually without exact limits or borders
ex: mountainous/coastal regions
山区／沿海地区

en: of or relating to a region
ex: services available at a local and regional level
本地和区域级别的服务

zh: one of the elected members of the Scottish Parliament who represents one of the regions of Scotland, in addition to the MSPs who represent a constituency. In elections, people vote for one constituency MSP and one regional member. All members have equal status in the Parliament.
en: one of the elected members of the Scottish Parliament who represents one of the regions of Scotland, in addition to the MSPs who represent a constituency. In elections, people vote for one constituency MSP and one regional member. All members have equal status in the Parliament.

zh: 地方分权主义；地域主义
en: a feature of a language that exists in a particular part of a country, and is not part of the standard language
ex: Regionalism is on the rise in Europe.
欧洲地区主义正在上升。

zh: in a way that is connected with a region
en: in a way that is connected with a region
ex: regionally based television companies
地方性的电视公司

zh: （正式地或公开地）发表意见，提出主张
en: to record your/somebody’s/something’s name on an official list
ex: You can also register online.
您也可以在线注册。

en: the official way of referring to a registry office
ex: The Leas married in a register office.
利夫妇是在户籍登记处登记结婚的。

en: a method of sending a letter or package in which the person sending it can claim money if it arrives late or is lost or damaged

zh: （获得正式资格的）注册护士；合格的护士
en: a nurse who has a degree in nursing and who has passed an exam to be allowed to work in a particular state
the sign or name of a product, etc. that is officially recorded and protected so that nobody else can use it

zh: （大学的）教务长，教务主任，注册主任
en: a person whose job is to keep official records, especially of births, marriages and deaths
ex: a paediatric registrar
儿科住院医生

zh: 车辆的登记号码；牌照号码
en: the act of making an official record of something/somebody
ex: the registration of letters and parcels
信件和包裹的挂号

zh: 车辆的登记号码；牌照号码
en: the series of letters and numbers that are shown on a number plate at the front and back of a vehicle to identify it
ex: I gave the registration number of the car to the police.
我把该车的车牌号告诉了警察。

en: a metal or plastic plate on the front and back of a vehicle that shows its registration number
ex: She could just about read the registration plate of the car speeding away from the accident.
她几乎可以读懂从事故中驶过的汽车的车牌。

en: a place where registers are kept; an official list or register
ex: The registry holds records of all major operations.
登记处有所有重大手术的记录。

zh: 户籍登记处（在英国可举办不涉及宗教仪式的婚礼，并负责登记出生及婚丧等事项）
en: (in the UK) a place where civil marriages (= that do not involve a religious ceremony) are performed and where records of births, marriages and deaths are made
ex: to get married in/at a registry office
在户籍登记处登记结婚
